## Company pages
- [Custom RFID & NFC Manufacturer](https://proudtek.com/): Proud Tek manufactures custom RFID cards, NFC tags, RFID labels, readers, wristbands and keyfobs for OEM, industrial, hotel and access-control use.
- [About Proud Tek](https://proudtek.com/about/): Learn about Proud Tek, a Shenzhen-based manufacturer of custom RFID cards, NFC tags, labels, readers, wristbands and keyfobs for OEM and industrial applications.
- [Proud Tek Blog](https://proudtek.com/blog/): Read RFID and NFC guides, application ideas and manufacturing insights from Proud Tek.
